# The file replaces Wiktionary's determiner, pronoun, preposition, conjunction,
# particle and auxiliary entries for every word listed here; nouns, verbs,
# adverbs and other content words stay (`la` the note, `pas` "step"), unless a
# line lists that part of speech too. A word's lines come first in the popover,
# in this file's order, so its commonest use goes first. Case matters.
